title.narrative: Improving Support for Enhancing Livelihoods of the Rural Poor

description.narrative: This programme seeks to improve the impact of FAO and partner agency interventions at country level through the application of Sustainable Livelihoods (SL) approaches and provide an opportunity for joint lesson learning to enhance the effectiveness of both FAO and DFID programmes. The programme purpose is to enable the FAO field and regular programmes to be more effective in applying SL approaches. If successful, the programme will contribute to the goal of improved field programmes, policies, and institutions that better support the livelihoods of the rural poor, by effective development interventions that assist in reaching the International Development Targets, as well as those of the 1996 World Food Summit.
